card.name: Reconstitution steps: until powder is dissolved
card.fires_on: The small word "is" right after "until the powder" (or the tablet) in mixing directions. It also fires on a few small words before a number or a title, such as "a" or "of" or an opening parenthesis.

modes.label: Powder is dissolved
modes.description: The linking word "is" after "until the powder" in vial reconstitution directions, just before "completely dissolved".
modes.example: Gently swirl each vial until the powder<< is>> completely dissolved.

modes.label: Small words before a quantity
modes.description: A short word such as "a" or "the" in a threshold or rating phrase, just before a number or measure.

modes.label: Titles and translations
modes.description: A bracket or "of" opening a translated title in scholarly text on Buddhist or medieval works.
